load_dataset_by_name: load a dataset by name and split using load_dataset to get a tf.data.Dataset builder
load_dataset_from_path: load a dataset from a directory path and split using load_dataset_from_path to get shards
get_metadata_by_name: get dataset metadata by name and version using get_metadata to retrieve num_classes and features
get_metadata_from_path: get dataset metadata from a file path using get_metadata_from_path with LRU caching
check_dataset_is_ready: check if a dataset is available and ready using check_dataset_is_ready before loading
